verdict.rationale: Polar's docs publish dated, versioned OpenAPI 3.1 specs (2026-04 and 2026-10) and refer to a versioned API reference, so API versioning is documented. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or migration guidance between versions. The probe 404s at root OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the specs are documented as served from the docs site. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle and migration guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: serves versioned OpenAPI specs straight from the docs site (2026-04.openapi.json and 2026-10.openapi.json, OpenAPI 3.1.0 — "Polar HTTP and Webhooks API")
